visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Numbers Sorted as Text
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The numbers should be sorted into [1,9,10,100], but the program prints [1,10,100,9].

solution.explanation: The default sort converts every item to a string and compares them alphabetically, so "10" comes before "9". A comparator that subtracts the two numbers sorts by value.
